lesson:
Think Backwards 💡◀️

Deepinder Goyal - Zomato Founder

For example na channel ki 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali anukondi.. then akkada nunchi backward think cheyyali. 1 Lakh Subscribers ravali ante first chala views kavali. 100 views ki oka subscriber osthunnadu anukondi.. then 10 Million Views kavali 1 Lakh subs kavali ante. So appudu na target viral videos mida undali. 1 Million views.. or 5 lakh views ala oche laga.. then 1 Lakh subs ochestaru

Zero To One Ideas - Peter Thiel

Eppudu kuda solve avvani problems kosam chudandi. Meeru oka product create cheste first adhi meeku chala useful ga undali. Tarvatha adhi mee friends ki chupisthe vallu danni chusi idhi already undi kada nenu ee product/app use chestunna ani cheppe la mee idea undakudadu. Appati varaku vallaki solve avvani problem ni meeru solve cheste appudu mee idea successful ayye chance peruguddi
source: Zero To One by Peter Thiel

lesson:
Viral Feature 🔥

Starting lo product ki fast ga users theeskoche daniki offers ivvadam, discounts ivvadam, cashbacks, referral incentives.. ila cheyyali..
Almost prathi company chestadi adhi. Jio, Paytm, even Elon Musk kuda X.Com pettinappudu chesadu

More Money = More Ownership Stake💲

Starting lo mee sontha money ekkuva pedithe.. tarvatha investors ochina kuda meeku knchm ekkuva stake untadi. Adey ganuka first nunchi funding midey depend aithe mee stake chala thaggipoddi. But indulo mana situation batti povali. First startup ni just experience, network, kosam treat cheste better. Appudu first startup ni ammesthey oche money tho 2nd startup pettandi then you'll have much stake. Elon Musk adey chesadu. Zip2 ammesthey ochina money ni X.com. danni ammesthey ochina money ni SpaceX & Tesla lo..
